aboutGame.title: What is Murderthon?
paragraphs: Murderthon is a 4v1 asymmetrical horror game on Roblox from Chilly Creations. Four survivors drop into a trial and race to repair the generators and open the exit gates, while a single masked killer hunts them through the map.

Every round is a chase. Survivors lean on stamina management, pallets, vents, and revives, while killers build around M.A.S.K abilities, tracking, and cooldown timing. Classes, talents, and unlockable masks let both sides tune a loadout before the match even starts.

modules.name: Murderthon Beginner Guide
modules.description: A first-session walkthrough of the Murderthon loop: which side you are on, how generators open the exit gates, and the movement habits that keep a new survivor alive past the first chase.

highlights.detail: Pick your side: four survivors race to escape while one killer hunts the map
Learn the objective loop — repair generators to power the exit gates before the timer runs out
Manage stamina: sprint only when you are being chased so you always have a burst left
Play around pallets, vaults, and vents to break the killer's line of sight
Revive and unhook downed teammates; a full squad escapes far more often than a solo runner
Bank your Shards and unlock a M.A.S.K before your next trial for a passive edge

modules.name: Murderthon Controls Guide
modules.description: A quick reference for the Murderthon control scheme — how to move, sprint, interact with objectives, vault mid-chase, and open the menu that holds your codes.

highlights.detail: Move with WASD, and sprint across open ground — running drains your stamina bar
Press E to interact with generators, exit gates, and map props
Jump and vault with Space to clear windows and low obstacles mid-chase
Swing with left-click as the killer — a mistimed swing costs you the chase
Trigger your equipped M.A.S.K ability from the ability bar when a chase turns
Open the *** menu in the bottom-left corner to redeem codes and adjust settings

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Murderthon.

items.question: What is Murderthon?
items.answer: Murderthon is a free 4v1 asymmetrical horror game on Roblox made by Chilly Creations. Four survivors work together to repair the generators and escape the trial while one masked killer hunts them down.

items.question: Which class should beginners pick in Murderthon?
items.answer: Handyman is the easiest Murderthon class for new survivors because its utility is simple to use, while Medic suits players who want to keep the squad alive. Run a few trials on each before committing to one role.

items.question: How do I redeem Murderthon codes?
items.answer: Open Murderthon, click the *** button in the bottom-left corner, type the code into the ENTER CODE box, and press REDEEM. Murderthon codes are case-sensitive, so enter them exactly as written.

items.question: How many players are in a Murderthon match?
items.answer: A standard Murderthon trial is a 4v1 match: four survivors against one killer. Survivors share generators, revives, and escape routes, while the killer has to split attention across the whole map.

items.question: What are M.A.S.K in Murderthon?
items.answer: M.A.S.K are the mask loadouts in Murderthon. Each mask carries its own stat modifiers and abilities, and both survivors and killers equip one to shape how they play the trial.
